# Case 006: Check-Out Works: Carpet Replacement and Repainting

## Case details
- source role: Agency manager
- created: 2024-09-20 13:25:35 UTC
- property: Flat 21, 11 Juniper Mews, Northbridge, ZZ7 0ZZ

## Initial request
Following the tenant vacating please provide an estimate to; 
1) Replace burnt carpet
2) Repaint through out

input.note:
Post-closure review of check-out works, Flat 21, 11 Juniper Mews, Northbridge ZZ7 0ZZ. Three record conflicts and one safety gap found; system closed the ticket at event-027.
1) Provider identity: provider assigned and briefed was Cedar Utilities (event-003, event-005; tenant told at event-004). The quote relayed to the landlord and the go-ahead were issued to "Sawyer" (event-013, event-016) and completion is logged as "Sawyer completed" (event-020). No event records Cedar Utilities being stood down or Sawyer being instructed.
2) Property: event-018 records "Sawyer attending Flat 12, 122 Juniper Mews, Westmarsh, ZZ8 7ZZ this week" — a different address — in the window between approval (event-016) and completion (event-020).
3) Scope: instructed brief was burnt carpet replacement + repaint (event-001). Approved quote (event-013/event-015, £605 total, VAT not stated) also covers bathroom vinyl £100 and a new chrome sink waste £45, and describes a "studio".
4) No visit slot was ever confirmed: 3+ reminders to provider (event-006, event-007, event-008); the only provider reply (event-012, untrusted, parsed summary) "does not mention appointment details".
5) Landlord completion confirmation was required at event-024 but no landlord message confirming completion appears in the history; closure at event-027 states all checks complete.
6) Safety: the works follow a burnt carpet (fire damage) and the property is being prepared to remarket (event-013). No record of smoke or carbon monoxide alarm testing. Must be confirmed before the flat is called ready for move-in.
No message sent to any party taking a side on items 1-2 (rule of engagement 2).

summary: Provider assigned and briefed was Cedar Utilities (event-003, event-005; tenant told event-004), but the quote, go-ahead and completion are all recorded against 'Sawyer' (event-013, event-016, event-020).
Event-018 places Sawyer at a different property — Flat 12, 122 Juniper Mews, Westmarsh ZZ8 7ZZ — in the window between approval and completion.
Landlord approved £220 paint + £240 carpet + £100 bathroom vinyl + £45 sink waste = £605, VAT not stated (event-013, event-015); the vinyl and sink waste go beyond the instructed brief (event-001).
Event-024 required landlord confirmation of completion; no landlord message confirming it appears in the history, yet event-027 closed the request as all checks complete.
Works follow a burnt carpet and the flat is being readied to remarket (event-013); no record anywhere of smoke or CO alarm testing.

Treat the works as verified on the strength of event-020 and leave the closure standing — accepts the risk that £605 of works were billed against the wrong address and that the flat is remarketed without an alarm test.
Instruct a brief post-works inspection (including alarm test) at Flat 21 before remarketing, then close with a resolution naming the payer.
